chunks.label: Phone and messages
chunks.rationale: Talk about your phone, apps and LINE messages.
chunks.interference: Rain here means the LINE app, not a drawn line.

chunks.label: Both, each, everything
chunks.rationale: Say both, each and all of something.
chunks.interference: Ryouhou is only for two; zentai is the whole as one, subete every part of it.

chunks.label: Half and the rest
chunks.rationale: Talk about part of something and what's left.
chunks.interference: Ichibu is 'some of' a whole; bubun is a specific part.

chunks.label: Songs and gigs
chunks.rationale: Talk about music you like and nights out singing or at shows.
chunks.interference: Kyoku is a song you listen to; uta is a song as sung.

chunks.label: Sport and exercise
chunks.rationale: Say what sports you play, watch or train for.
chunks.interference: Taikai is the whole tournament; a single game is shiai.

chunks.label: Walks and holidays
chunks.rationale: Talk about strolls, summer break and spring outings.
chunks.interference: Sanpo is walking for pleasure; walking somewhere is aruku.

chunks.label: Computer and charging
chunks.rationale: Handle everyday device trouble: battery, charger, wifi, screen.
chunks.interference: Juuden is the charge; juudenki is the charger.

chunks.label: Videos, manga, social media
chunks.rationale: Talk about what you watch, read and post.
chunks.interference: Douga is an online video; a TV show is bangumi.

chunks.label: Looks and what's inside
chunks.rationale: Describe how something looks versus what it really is.
chunks.interference: Mitame (looks) and nakami (what's inside) are opposites.

chunks.label: Types and levels
chunks.rationale: Talk about kinds of things, sets and how good something is.
chunks.interference: Taipu and shurui both mean 'kind'; only taipu means 'my type'.

chunks.label: Letters and numbers
chunks.rationale: Talk about writing, signatures, figures and how many.
chunks.interference: Ji and moji overlap; kazu is how many, suuji is the figure itself.

chunks.label: Over, within, except
chunks.rationale: Put limits on amounts and times, and leave things out.
chunks.interference: Igai (except) sounds like igai (surprising); ijou and inai include the number.

chunks.label: Next, last, the end
chunks.rationale: Say what comes next, what's last and when it's over.
chunks.interference: Tsuzuki is what follows; nokori is what's left.

chunks.label: Top, biggest, only
chunks.rationale: Talk about the best, the biggest, huge amounts and the only one.
chunks.interference: Saidai is the biggest single thing; tairyou is a big amount.

chunks.label: Where and which way
chunks.rationale: Ask and say where something is and which way to go.

chunks.label: That thing, copying, impulse
chunks.rationale: Refer to 'that thing', copying, acting on impulse and harsh people.
chunks.interference: Rei no is 'that one'; rei alone is 'example'.

drops.reason: Duplicate of ライン (same word and rank, the LINE app); kept under ライン.
